about: Expected case counts for verify.py. A group passes only if it executes exactly this many cases and all pass.

season.what: 23 setups x 2 seasons rerun; capture, big-storm capture, runoff depths, .rpt vs .out runoff, continuity

ablation.what: 9 VG option cases x 2 seasons rerun; big-storm and all-storm capture

vg_checks.what: closed column (EXP, Mualem), drying column, no-upward-flow column

storm8.what: eight-inch storm cases; infiltration, runoff, kept, storage, peak

parity.what: null effect: swmm524-perched vs EPA 5.2.4 on inputs with no SOIL2/VG/STRUCT line; 896 recovery + 28 season + 6 eight-inch inputs; .out and LID report byte-identical

openswmm.what: stock, fix, OpenSWMM 5.3.0-beta.3 legacy, OpenSWMM 6.0.0-alpha.4 on season, eight-inch and SOIL2 inputs

tolerance_notes.rpt_vs_out_in: The Results tab states the .out-integrated runoff matches the .rpt totals within 0.033 in (largest gap: Hmax dormant, 18.656 vs 18.623 in). The .out file holds rates at report times; the .rpt total integrates every runoff step. This check enforces the published figure.
tolerance_notes.capture_pct: Stored capture values are rounded to 0.1 %; a deterministic engine must reproduce them exactly.
tolerance_notes.depth_in: Stored depths are rounded to 0.001 in.
